summary: Carter County tower site: a 100-foot steel tower erected in 1962 was sold and removed from the site in February 2023.

facts.status_note: Tower sold and removed from the site in February 2023; no source describes what remains there.

events.note: Towersite of 40 acres acquired by the Missouri Conservation Commission (fiscal 1947-48)
Towerman John D. (Turley) Webb, per a September 1948 newspaper report
Joe L. Bounds begins as a permanent towerman on February 1, 1949
100-foot steel tower erected; an August 1974 article says Joe Bounds started on Feb. 1, 1949 at the 'newly constructed' tower (see resolved_conflicts)
Tower sold and removed from the site in February 2023

evidence.supports: Tower is in Carter County, Missouri (record header)
evidence.quote: Missouri Lookouts - Carter County - Missouri Conservation Commission
FY 1947-48: A 40 acre towersite was acquired.

evidence.supports: September 1948 newspaper report: John D. (Turley) Webb is towerman at Hunter and attending fire-control school
evidence.quote: John D. (Turley) Webb who is Towerman at Hunter for the Missouri conservation commission is attending a week on fire control school at the lake of the Ozarks.

evidence.supports: Joe Bounds began as a permanent towerman in February 1949 at the newly constructed tower
evidence.quote: Joe was employed on a permanent basis Feb. 1, 1949 as a towerman for the newly constructed Hunter lookout tower.

evidence.supports: March 1951 newspaper: a district forester says some fires still burning but all under control
evidence.quote: some fires still burning today but all are under control

evidence.supports: March 1951 newspaper: smoke still reported from the Hunter fire tower
evidence.quote: Smoke still was reported from the Hunter fire tower

evidence.supports: Tower sold and removed from the site in February 2023
evidence.quote: February 2023: The Hunter tower sold and removed from the site.

corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts history says the tower was sold and removed from the site in February 2023

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page quotes an August 1974 article saying Joe Bounds started on Feb. 1, 1949 at the 'newly constructed' Hunter tower, but the same page dates the 100-foot steel tower's erection to 1962. The story gives 1962 for the steel tower and notes the 1949 reference.

notes_for_editor: Single source: every fact comes from the Forest Lookouts page, which reproduces contemporaneous newspaper and annual-report entries. A Missouri Conservation Commission Facebook photo post (a search result) describes the tower as formerly located in Carter County and says it replaced an earlier 60-foot wooden tower; the page would not open, so nothing from it is cited. Brief status 'unknown' corrected to removed. Brief height 30.5 m refers to the 1962 steel tower, which is no longer on the site. No source describes the site today.
